extractionMethod.note: Read directly from the property's own page, header 'SOROI BLUE / DIANI' present with the figures.

structuralFindings: Base meal plan is HALF BOARD, not Full Board — every other property checked uses Full Board as the base with a Ground Package upgrade. There is no 'Ground Package' concept here at all (no game drives at a beach property); instead there are optional Full Board and All-Inclusive supplements.
No mandatory conservancy/park fee of any kind — makes sense for a beach resort, but is a genuine structural difference from every inland property, all of which have one.
Season calendar shape is different: Peak here is a single short window (20 Dec-3 Jan) rather than the two-range Peak seen at every inland property. Shoulder is the majority of the year.
Room-level occupancy varies by specific room name, not just by category — some rooms (Tiwi, Wasini) are 2-adults-only with no child capacity, unlike others in the same rate row.
